items.evidence: The Scorecard focuses on our most important business drivers: (1) revenue, (2) earnings per share, and (3) pipeline milestones.
The revenue and earnings metrics are equally weighted because the C&B Committee believes they are the key financial measures of our success
the pipeline metric is included because it is a leading indicator of the Company's ability to create sustainable value for shareholders
U.S. filing and approval of KEYTRUDA for treatment of patients with metastatic non-small cell lung cancer whose tumors express PD-L1 were achieved ahead of schedule.
U.S. filing of ZEPATIER for treatment of patients with chronic hepatitis C virus (HCV) infection was achieved slightly ahead of schedule.
Received approval of five other products, including BRIDION in the U.S., MARIZEV in Japan
Progressed late-stage drugs through various stages of development, including products for cancer, Alzheimer's disease, diabetes and C. difficile infection.
Augmented pipeline through an agreement with NGM Biopharmaceuticals (diabetes & obesity) and the acquisition of cCAM Biotherapeutics
these results, combined with individual performance, determine annual incentive payouts to the majority of our employees
The PSUs granted for the 2013-2015 performance period provided senior executives the opportunity to earn share awards based on EPS performance
the payout was reduced by 20% due to our three-year annualized TSR of 10.6%, which ranked 10 of 12 among our industry peers.
Performance is now measured using equal components of relative TSR and adjusted operating cash flow, both over a cumulative three-year period
